notes: Syntax-safe one-shot fresh NotebookLM creation validation. Writes an ENTRY receipt before work, verifies the already-restored bridge 0.2.75, SHA-verifies the isolated fresh-notebook CDP helper, writes it with UTF-8 BOM, and requires a genuinely new /notebook/<id> different from the historical notebook. Existing generation/download runner is untouched. Flow is not a prerequisite; normal Chrome, OAuth, scopes and paid actions are untouched.
